title: Gate curriculum, generated problems, and card capsules
summary: Defer curriculum/problem generation and spaced-repetition card capsules until semantic transformations, computation protocols, frame preservation, and flashcard specs are stable enough to generate verified solution assets.

sourceRefs.summary: Computation protocol metadata for objects that qualify.
Generated algebra fixtures that could later back verified problem sets.

expectedLearning: Which generated solution assets are mathematically verified enough to become tutorial capsules or spaced-repetition prompts.
How concept prerequisites, misconceptions, and learner memory should reference stable semantic object ids.
Which flashcard prompt types can be generated from existing transformation and frame data.
allowedWork: Keep this as a gated design and breakdown until prerequisite protocols are stable.
Use existing flashcard specs and generated algebra fixtures as examples.
disallowedWork: Do not build learner memory, concept graph, or bulk problem generation yet.
Do not generate unverified math or solution steps.
revisitWhen: After reusable semantic transformations, computation protocols, and media/frame laws prove solution provenance.
